fixed: The program matrix no longer flags the last dance before a break and the first dance after it as sharing beats with an adjacent dance (or sharing a phrase). A break separates two dances; a waltz or a note between two dances does not.

changed: `ProgramMatrix.isCollision` skips a neighbouring row in a different numbered section, so dances either side of a break are never adjacent. Rows without a section, and slots in the same section, are compared as before.
